title: After upgrading to the latest tpatch version, methodically audit and repair historical feature artifacts whose generated recipes replay but canonical patches fail dependency-closure verification because older bundled shared-file baselines are incomplete. Work topologically, preserve append-only generations, add truthful dependencies or narrow feature boundaries, use tpatch rebind/repair tooling if available, and produce a verification report. This is deferred backlog maintenance and must not block product work while recipe replay and code tests remain green.
